column1: # HTTP verbs recovered from the CSS class on each doc page's request table
# (class="CHHttpRequest CHHttpRequest_<verb>"). The verb is never rendered as text in the
# docs - it is an image plus this class - so this is the only machine-readable source.
# 200 request blocks across 150 pages, 0 unparsed. The verb column is EVIDENCE.
# Two paths are marked CORRECTED: the CSS block provably exists and its verb is reliable, but
# the URL the block printed is wrong, so the path was fixed by hand against the raw HTML:
#   PUT .../orders/ack       - block printed the bySeller URL above it (copy-paste artifact);
#                              its heading, params table and example all say ack.
#   POST .../quickLabels/delete - block printed a bare /resto/api/v2/ (empty bold segment);
#                              completed from the same page's example URL.
